name: PLN
fix_description: Add access control or rate limiting to liqBurnAt. Currently anyone can trigger it via transferFrom(excluded_addr, 0xdead, any_amount), which burns almost all tokens from the LP pair and calls sync(). Add onlyOwner restriction, or a cooldown period, or limit the burn amount per call.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a very short, direct sequence: buy the vulnerable token, trigger the bug with a zero-amount transferFrom, then sell back for profit. It uses only basic token/router interactions and an obvious abnormal behavior in token logic, with no flash loans, complex state reasoning, or multi-protocol chaining.
